item.text:
Implemented [`createPost`](/workspace/app/actions.ts) as a Server Action. It validates input, saves the post, then calls **`updateTag('posts')`**.

`updateTag` immediately expires cached data, so the next read blocks until fresh data is fetched. It does not serve stale content while revalidating.

Added a form and tagged posts list, using local file storage because the starter had no database.

Verified: all 3 tests and the production build pass. A live submission against a warmed cache showed the new post immediately and on the first subsequent page load.
